Bull. 2509C, Volumetric Shrinkage Resulting from Blending Volatile Hydrocarbons with Crude Oils, Second Edition, 1967

This publication presents data on the subject of volumetric changes resulting from blending volatile hydrocarbons (propane, butane, produced distillates, and natural gasolines) with crude oils. This publication is not included in the current manual. 21 pages.

Price each, $3.00
